io.milvus.v2.client.globalcluster

Class GlobalStub

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.client.globalcluster.GlobalStub

  • public class GlobalStub
extends Object
    Manages the client connection to the primary cluster of a global cluster deployment.

    On construction the stub fetches the global topology, connects to the primary cluster, and starts a background TopologyRefresher. When the topology changes, the stub swaps to a new client for the new primary endpoint and notifies the registered primary-change callback.
